turns.text: Hi, I'd like to change my flight to Mumbai, please.
Sure, I can help. May I have your booking code and last name?
It's CC7L9N, and the last name is Rahman.
Thank you, Ms. Rahman, you're verified. I see SK512 to Mumbai on Friday at 9 PM. What would you like to change?
I want to move it to the Saturday morning one, the 7:45. It's a Flex fare, so that should be free, right?
The change itself is free on a Flex fare, so there's no change fee. The SK510 on Saturday at 7:45 is $210 versus your $190, so there's a $20 fare difference to pay.
Wait, what? Twenty dollars? I thought Flex meant no cost at all.
I understand the confusion. Flex waives the change fee, but the fare difference still applies, and that's the $20 here.
Wait, what, so Flex doesn't cover that part? Is there any way to not pay the twenty?
I'm sorry, I can't waive the fare difference under our policy. I can offer a supervisor callback if you'd like to discuss it further.
Hmm, okay. It's only twenty dollars, so I guess I'll just do it. Go ahead and move me to the 7:45.
Done. You're now on SK510 Saturday at 7:45 with a $20 fare difference and no change fee, to your card on file.
